__stickynote1.text:
Do not delete these outputs, they are essential for the node to function properly.

If you do delete them accidentally, use the "Fix SOP Outputs" button on the HDA interface.

__stickynote2.text: REQUIRED: Connect your geometry to 'default' if you aren't sure what you want. Otherwise your Component asset won't have any geometry.

__stickynote3.text:
If you have a low-resolution version of your model you want to see in GL, connect it to 'proxy'.

This will give it the 'proxy' display purpose in USD, and will also set the geometry connected to 'default' to have the 'render' display purpose - meaning it will only show up in Karma or other renderers. You can change GL to see render purpose, but normally that isn't enabled.

__stickynote4.text: Will create special guide geometry, which is used for the physics tools in the Edit LOP and Drop LOP.
